subject: Add "Copy All to Clipboard" to PuTTY connection tab context menu
body:
Add "Copy All to Clipboard" to PuTTY connection tab context menu

Posts WM_SYSCOMMAND with IDM_COPYALL (0x170) to the embedded PuTTY
window, the same technique already used for the PuTTY Settings menu
item (IDM_RECONF). Dumps the entire scrollback to the clipboard in
one click, useful for grabbing full Cisco config output.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: The backend exists, but the requested tab action does not. Add only UI wiring using the existing method and resource, avoiding duplicate backend and localization.

votes.concern: The patch duplicates the fork's existing PuttyBase.CopyAllToClipboard method, so direct import conflicts and cannot compile.
votes.reason: Menu exposure is useful, but only its UI wiring should be reimplemented against the existing method; this commit is not directly landable.
The backend method already exists in our fork. This commit would cause merge conflicts and code duplication, requiring a clean manual reimplementation.
